title: Penthouse Magazine February 2008 Complete w/ Centerfold Ice Cube Will Leitch
conditionDescription: Covers clean and bright with no tears. Light wear at the bottom of the spine (see photo 2) and light edge wear. Complete with centerfold. See photos.
descriptionText:
Penthouse magazine, February 2008 issue, original $7.99 cover price. Complete with centerfold.

Cover features: Ice Cube speaks out; Deadspin's Will Leitch; five pictorials.

Back cover: Djarum clove cigarettes ad.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
